samples.xml_description:
<module id="adder_16bit">
    <description>Implement a module of a 16-bit full adder in combinational logic.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="a" width_description="[15:0]">16-bit input operand A.</input>
        <input id="b" width_description="[15:0]">16-bit input operand B.</input>
        <input id="Cin">Carry-in input. The module name "Cin" is case-sensitive.</input>
        <output id="y" width_description="[15:0]">16-bit output representing the sum of A and B.</output>
        <output id="Co">Carry-out output. The module name "Co" is case-sensitive.</output>
    </ports>
    <implementation>In the adder_16bit module, you need to design a small bit-width adder(8-bit adder), which will be instantiated multiple times. The 8-bit adder module utilizes a series of bit-level adders (full adders) to perform the addition operation.</implementation>
</module>
